title: Gather your friends for this new social deduction game: Gang Birds! (4-10 Players)
author: Designer-Number3202
selftext:
This will be my first commercial game called Gang Birds coming on Steam in 2 weeks from now.  
If you want to try it now you can play it on my itch page - link is in the comments

What is this Game about?  
Gang Birds is a turn-based game of bluffing and social deduction best played with 4-10 players. Uncover secret teams, play cards at any time and aim at the right bird.  
Earch turn you can chose between drawing a card, taking a weapon and aiming at someone or observing one team identity.

If someone gets shot there are two possibilites: Take the damage or reveal one of your teamcards so everyone on the table gets information on which team you might be.

The Teams are: Gang, Cops and Junkie each with a different win condition  
If someone died the game makes a check if one team won, if not the game continues

Why its awesome and fun?  
There is an ingame voice chat so you can talk, lie, and discuss and the best thing, the birds open their mouth as you speak.

The character editor is inspired by spore so there are many possibilites how your bird can look.

You can do a lot of emotes like smoking, drinking or throwing some money on the table
